456765.overview: Hiyoko Fighter is an action game where you play as Peter - a chick who collects eggs from hens that will drop a white eggs for 30 points, red eggs for 50 points and will make Peter angry and invincible for some time, or yellow egg to clear the stage while avoiding worms that will chase and ambush you. If Peter finds a sign you can teleport to the top. Peter can attack the green worm for 100 points but not the purple worm because it's invincible but you can go through it. If Peter gets caught by them he'll fall down and lose a life.

456769.overview: Help! is an action game where you take on the role of a man climbing on vines attached to a tree and stopping seven yellow snakes from reaching the top to cut the apple that will fall on the girl causing you as well to fall down resulting in an instant game over. You also have to watch out for the blue striped yellow snakes that appear from the grass because you'll fall down and receive an out which means you lost a life if that happens or if there are no vines at the end of the right or left side. You can hit the yellow snakes for 10 points and the red striped yellow snakes for 100 points. Once you hit a certain number of yellow snakes you move on to the next stage.

456770.overview: In Hey Sheep! you control a shepherd boy who must gather his sheep into the fencing before nightfall so he can go on a date with a girl. You can catch the sheep by running into them and then once you drag them to the top of the screen you can close the gate by pressing up on the underside of it and going in the direction to shut it. However in later levels a wolf appears and he’ll open the gate which allows the sheep to escape. If you fail to get all the sheep locked away safely by nightfall the game is over.
